checks.name: Pen mode hides the selected rectangle and resize handles
Drawing inside a rectangle creates a stroke instead of moving it
Finished stroke has no bounding box selection
Freehand keeps the sampled pointer path
Crossing an existing stroke starts an independent stroke
Crossing does not reshape the previous stroke
Undo removes the entire last stroke
Edge-clamped strokes remain valid for export
Stroke bounds do not extend beyond the image
Click without dragging creates a one-point stroke
A single pen click produces a visible exported dot
Highlighter also remains freehand without resize handles
Highlighter adds an independent deselected stroke
Explicit Select mode enables editing frames
Clicking empty space in Select mode does not draw or add undo history
New strokes use the chosen pen width
